jobs.title: Biz Ops Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIROPS

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.

Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

As our Biz Ops Lead, you'll build the operational and analytical foundation that scales AirOps to $100M and beyond. This is a high-ownership, high-leverage role — part operator, part strategist, part builder — where no task is too small and no problem is too ambiguous. You'll systematize the repetitive, sprint into the strategic, and help the business run faster and smarter at every layer.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and own the operating cadences that keep AirOps aligned and moving — Annual Planning, WBRs, OKRs, etc.

 - Design AI-native workflows across Deal Desk, Business Reporting, and workspace management using AirOps, Claude, and other tools

 - Embed into functions for 2–4 week strategic sprints — diagnosing problems, structuring solutions, and driving them to completion

 - Own deep analytical work - leadership reporting to deep-dive analyses across pricing, customer cohorts, sales capacity, strategic forecasting etc.

 - Identify and size new opportunities — verticals, pricing motions, expansion plays — with clear unit economics and a path to execution

 - Manage core operational infrastructure: compliance, vendor management, and G&A services


WHO YOU ARE

 - 5+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, chief of staff, or business operations role in a high-growth environment.

 - Highly analytical — you build revenue models, cohort analyses, pricing tests, and capacity scenarios from scratch, and turn data into clear recommendations

 - Automation-native — you reach for AI tools instinctively, vibe-code workflows, and eliminate manual work wherever you find it

 - Systems-oriented — you instinctively turn recurring work into structured frameworks, not one-off solutions

 - Fast context-switcher — you embed into a new function and contribute meaningfully within days

 - Strategy and execution-focused — you drive projects to completion and own outcomes, not just facilitate meetings

 - Comfortable across functions — you move fluidly across finance, GTM, and product without losing clarity or momentum

 - Strong communicator — equally crisp writing an exec summary or facilitating a leadership offsite

 - Low-ego — you take the unglamorous work as seriously as the high-visibility stuff

 - Thrive in ambiguity — you bring structure, prioritization, and velocity to fast-moving environments.

Bonus:

 - Shipped something with AI — built a workflow, tool, or automation that people actually used

 - Revenue strategy exposure — you understand how dollars flow through the business, from pricing and packaging to pipeline and margin

 - High-growth SaaS experience — you've seen the $10M–$100M ARR inflection points firsthand


OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES

 1. Extreme Ownership

 2. Quality

 3. Curiosity and Play

 4. Make Our Customers Heroes

 5. Respectful Candor


BENEFITS

 - Equity in a fast-growing startup

 - Competitive benefits package tailored to your location

 - Flexible time off policy

 - Parental Leave 

 - A fun-loving and (just a bit) nerdy team that loves to move fast!

ABOUT AIROPS

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.


ABOUT THE ROLE

AirOps is expanding into larger enterprise partnerships that bring together owned content, external content, and emerging channels such as AI advertising. We’re looking for an Enterprise Strategy Lead to help senior marketing leaders connect their business goals to the right investments across AI search.

This is an individual contributor role partnering closely with Account Executives throughout the enterprise sales process. You’ll lead strategic discovery with senior buyers and build account strategies yourself, from research and analysis to the story you present to a customer. Your work will help customers understand where to invest, what outcomes to expect, and how an initial program can grow over time.

You’ll shape how we approach each opportunity, assess whether there’s a strong fit, and build the business case for the recommended program. You’ll also turn successful approaches into frameworks and materials the broader sales team can use.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead strategic discovery. Understand each buyer’s business goals, marketing investments, priorities, and constraints.

 - Build account strategies. Recommend an initial program across relevant AI-search channels, with a clear rationale, expected outcomes, and a path to expansion.

 - Own the research and analysis. Identify the data needed, conduct the analysis, and turn findings into a compelling story for senior marketing leaders.

 - Shape enterprise deals. Work alongside Account Executives in daily deal discussions to strengthen the business case, improve win rates, and define the right starting program size.

 - Qualify opportunities. Assess customer fit, expansion potential, and whether the proposed program aligns with what AirOps can deliver.

 - Coordinate specialists. Bring in product, research, and channel experts when needed, with clear questions and focused briefs.

 - Build the playbook. Translate successful deal strategies into discovery frameworks, account planning tools, and sales materials the team adopts.
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - 4+ years of experience at a leading management consulting firm such as McKinsey, Bain, or BCG, ideally within a growth, marketing, or go-to-market practice.

 - Experience developing and presenting growth or marketing strategy recommendations to CMOs and other senior marketing leaders.

 - Experience working directly alongside sales teams on active enterprise opportunities.

 - A strong understanding of marketing budgets, channel investment decisions, and how they connect to business outcomes.

 - The ability to work from raw data through analysis to a clear, persuasive recommendation—and to do that work yourself.

 - Sound judgment about when specialist expertise is needed and how to brief experts effectively.

 - Comfort working through ambiguity and building repeatable approaches as you go.
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a startup.

 - Familiarity with AI search, SEO, or content marketing.

 - Experience creating enablement materials and frameworks that sales teams actively use.


OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES

 1. Extreme Ownership

 2. Quality

 3. Curiosity and Play

 4. Make Our Customers Heroes

 5. Respectful Candor


BENEFITS

 - Equity in a fast-growing startup

 - Competitive benefits package tailored to your location

 - Flexible time off policy

 - Parental Leave

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Our customers are some of the earliest and most sophisticated teams building for the future of AI search. Their results and experiences are among the most powerful ways we can demonstrate what’s possible with AirOps and establish trust in a rapidly evolving category.



We’re looking for a Senior Customer Marketing Manager to turn those outcomes into compelling evidence and advocacy. You’ll build a rich library of case studies, videos, customer quotes, proof points, references, and speakers that brings the AirOps story to life across our marketing and sales efforts.



AirOps has a strong foundation of customer relationships and advocacy, but our existing programs were built for an earlier chapter of the company. As we expand to new enterprise buyers, use cases, and solutions, you’ll rethink and rebuild our approach for where we’re going next. You’ll draw on what we’ve learned and the relationships we’ve established without being constrained by the programs or content that exist today.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Rebuild AirOps’ customer marketing and advocacy strategy for our next stage of growth, with a focus on new enterprise buyers, solutions, and use cases.

 - Develop a strong pipeline and library of case studies, videos, customer quotes, proof points, and other stories across priority industries and personas.

 - Partner with Customer Success, Services, Sales, and Data to identify meaningful customer outcomes and turn them into credible, differentiated narratives.

 - Reimagine the customer reference program, expanding our advocate network and making it easy to connect the right customers with the right opportunities.

 - Identify gaps in the proof needed to support enterprise sales conversations and proactively develop stories that address them.

 - Build a network of customer advocates and speakers for sales opportunities, events, webinars, media, and other high-impact moments.

 - Own the AirOps Customer Advisory Board end to end, including member strategy, programming, executive participation, meeting execution, and ongoing engagement.




WHO YOU ARE

 - 6+ years of experience in customer marketing, customer advocacy, product marketing, or a related role at a B2B software company.

 - Proven experience creating compelling customer stories from interviews, implementation details, and business results.

 - Experience selling to enterprise customers and a strong understanding of the proof points, narratives, and outcomes that resonate with enterprise buyers across industries.

 - Experience rebuilding or significantly evolving a customer reference or advocacy program within a sales-led go-to-market motion.

 - A strong interviewer, writer, and storyteller with excellent judgment about what makes a customer story distinctive and credible.

 - Able to learn from what already exists while challenging assumptions and designing a program for a new audience and stage of growth.

 - A trusted, highly organized partner who can work effectively with customers, executives, and cross-functional teams while balancing persistence with empathy.
   
   


OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES

 1. Extreme Ownership

 2. Quality

 3. Curiosity and Play

 4. Make Our Customers Heroes

 5. Respectful Candor

 - Equity in a fast-growing startup

 - Competitive benefits package tailored to your location
